Commentary.Commentary: Jason Holder was the one who troubled the Lankans a touch. They never bowled enough good balls to put pressure. The skipper finished with 3 for 57 and that was the only saving grace for a disastrous display on the field. West Indies have never chased a target of 300 in ODIs and they are up against history today. They have a young batting line-up and they will be tested to the stretch as Sri Lanka look firm favorites to book their place in the final. Let's see how they go. Join us in a while for the chase.

Both Kusal Mendis and Niroshan Dickwella missed out on their tons, getting out on 94 but not before ensuring Sri Lanka had a par score on the board. Wickets did tumble towards the end but the twin century stands had already put Sri Lanka ahead. Tharanga, Pathirana chipped in with handy cameos to take them to the 330-run mark.

What a finish from Sri Lanka! They have registered their highest ever ODI total against West Indies and boy, they have been ruthless today. West Indies asked Sri Lanka to bat first on a green looking deck after winning the toss but that is all that went their way. Sri Lanka began rapidly and despite losing Kusal Perera, they continued to motor along.

OUT! Wicket on the final delivery of the innings. Back of a length on the body, Tharanga gets a top edge on his pull shot and the ball lobs over towards backward square leg. Ashley Nurse is the man there and he runs to his left to take a simple catch. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 330/7!
Full toss outside off, Sachith Pathirana gets it off the outer half and lofts it over cover-point. Runs to the other end and completes the single.
Spears it in on the pads, goes off the pads on the off side as Upul looks to flick it across the line. A leg bye is taken.
Short of a length ball on the body, Sachith Pathirana rises and works it on the on side for a brisk single.
Good variation from Jason Holder. He takes the pace off this fuller ball and beats the wild shot from Pathirana.
Fired in full and outside off, no wide called as it's just inside the wide line.
FOUR! Another big over for the Islanders. 12 runs off it. It's pitched on a length outside off, Tharanga lofts it over covers and beats the fielder out in the deep. Boundary to end the over.
Brathwaite pitches this up there and attacks the stumps, it's worked down towards long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE! Pathirana walks down the track to this back of a length delivery. It's going down leg and it's a wide signalled.
Fuller and slower around off, Upul Tharanga lofts it down to long on for one run.
Good length delivery just around off, Sachith Pathirana backs away and cuts it late down towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Straying on the hips, Pathirana just glances this away down towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Pushed to the covers region and that's a single taken. 10 runs off the over, another good one for the Lankans.
This is played square of the wicket as Pathirana gets it away. Another double.
Another shorter ball which is pulled away. It's through the mid-wicket area as two more runs are taken.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length delivery around off, Tharanga dabs it to backward point and sets off. Quick running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second run.

DROPPED! That's poor from Charles. Holder's expression says it all. Shortish delivery banged into the body from around the wicket, Upul Tharanga gets a top edge as he looks to pull it away. It flies towards backward square leg as Charles comes running in from the deep. Tumbles forward but lets the ball slip through his hands. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Big over this for Sri Lanka. 13 runs have come off it. Short of a length around off, Pathirana slaps it over extra cover off the back foot and ends the over with a boundary.

FOUR! That's beautifully placed in the gap. Short of a length outside off, Sachith Pathirana backs away a bit and slaps it over backward point. Beats the fielder out in the deep and sends it across the ropes.
Yorker arrowed in on the stumps, it's dug out back towards mid on. Some good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Isn't exactly in control of it but does well in the end to get the pull shot away off the inside half on the leg side. A run is taken.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Pathirana pulls it through the square leg region for one run.
Short of a length delivery angling into the body, Tharanga swivels across and pulls it aerially towards fine leg for a single.
Fired in full on middle, flicked straight to the mid-wicket fielder and that will be the end of the over.
Just back of a length on the stumps, it's turned with the wrists to square leg for a single.
SACHITH PATHIRANA walks in to bat.

OUT! Length ball from Jason Holder, it's in the slot as Asela Gunaratne slogs this over mid-wicket. He doesn't get hold of it at all and it's taken by Rovman Powell out in the deep who runs in a few paces to take it. Another wicket down for Sri Lanka.
Length ball outside off, it's whacked through to sweeper cover for a run.

FOUR! From around the wicket, Holder bowls it just ahead of a length and gets it to angle in from around off, Upul Tharanga stands firm and lofts it over the covers. No real protection out in the deep and that will run away to the fence.
Length ball coming in on middle and leg, Asela Gunaratne works it through mid-wicket for one.
JASON HOLDER comes back on for a bowl.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full toss outside off, it's played to point for a single.
Over the wicket now, length ball outside off, Gunaratne runs it down to third man for a run.
Tharanga backs away in an attempt to hit it on the off side but Carlos follows him. It's slightly on a back of a length but the left-hander does well to turn it on the leg side. One run taken.
From around the wicket, it's on a length, Tharanga looks to hit it away on the off side but misses.
Full and attacking the stumps, it's flicked through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Some flight on that from Ashley Nurse, Gunaratne drives it through the cover region for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Darts this full on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for a run.
ASELA GUNARATNE is the new man in.

OUT! That's a soft dismissal. Not the way you'd have imagined Kusal Mendis getting out. It's flat, short and wide outside off, going away from around the wicket, Mendis gets greedy and looks to guide it late towards third man. Ends up getting a nick and Shai Hope takes it in his gloves. He's gone but not before playing a superb knock.
SIX! Two in two for Kusal Mendis. He is on the charge here. Crouches low to this full ball and hammers it back down the ground. Clears the ropes with ease as he moves on to 94.
SIX! THAT'S OUT OF HERE! Full on the stumps, it's in the slot and Mendis is not going to let it go. He gets low and slog sweeps it hard over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen.
Short of a length outside off, steered to short third man to end the over.

FOUR! Think he was going for the yorker there and he's missed his mark by some distance. High full toss around off, Tharanga cuts it away between short third man and gully to send it all the way. The chasing fielders tried their best but failed in their attempt to stop it.
Fractionally fuller and it's angling in on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Fuller and slower from Carlos Brathwaite, around off, Kusal Mendis drives it to covers. Dot ball.
A deep square leg is in place now..
Length delivery around off, with an open face Upul Tharange drives it square towards backward point for a single.
WIDE! Bowls this way, way outside off. It goes across the wide line and the umpire signals it as a wide.
UPUL THARANGA is the new man in.

OUT! Carlos Brathwaite instantly strikes on return. He comes from around the wicket and fires it in full just outside off, Shehan Jayasuriya looks to smack it through the covers but gets a thick inside edge. It crashes back onto the stumps and that spells the end for the southpaw.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE returns for a bowl.
Kusal leans ahead and places it through extra cover. Places it well in the gap and as a result, gets a couple of runs.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Kusal Mendis gets low to this one and top edges the pull through backward square leg. There's nobody there and so, no danger. One run taken.
SIX! Juicy full toss from Ashley Nurse, Kusal Mendis stands tall and murders the pull shot. Clears the mid-wicket fence with ease and gets a biggie to his name.
Tossed up outside off, eased to covers for one.

Not out! He was well in there. He plays this fuller ball down to long on and quickly wants the second. Mendis is the one at the bowler's end and he slides his bat in as the throw is fired in. Holder whips the bails off and it goes upstairs. Replays confirm that Mendis survives.
A run out decision against Mendis is referred upstairs by the umpire.
ASHLEY NURSE comes back on for a bowl.
Low full toss around off, it's drilled towards extra cover for a single.
Back of a length on the body, the ball gets big on Shehan as he gets a top edge on his pull shot. It clears the infield and goes towards deep mid-wicket for a double.
From around the wicket, it's on a length and shaping in from around off, Jayasuriya misses as he attempts to cut it away.
Full toss attacking the stumps, it's worked through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Mendis clips it towards mid-wicket for no run.

Fuller length ball coming in on middle and leg, raps Jayasuriya on the pads as he looks to flick it across the line. Loud shout for a leg before but it's turned down. It was going down leg. A leg bye is taken.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Now, 5 fielders will be allowed outside the circle.
SIX! SMACKED! Bowls another full toss outside off, Kusal Mendis and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a maximum. That ends a tough day for Benn, he finishes with figures of 10-0-59-0!
Low full toss, squirted past point for a couple of runs by Mendis.
Plays this one back to the bowler.
Drives it through covers but not in the gap.
This time he gets it through covers for a single off the leading edge.
Punches this one off his back foot towards covers.
Another short one, Kusal thinks to hook at first but then lets it go.
Bouncer! Shorter length on the stumps, but it is too short and Kusal lets it go over him with a duck.
Pulls this one through square leg for a single.
On a length on off, Jayasuriya comes forward and defends it.
SHEHAN JAYASURIYA is the new man in.

OUT! Dickwella reviews in vain! Angles it on a fuller length on middle, Dickwella plays all over it from his crease but is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire upholds it. Dickwella goes for the review since he is closer to his maiden ton. The replays confirm no bat and Ball Tracker shows three reds and that's it, Dickwella has to go back and he misses out on a well deserving ton.
Niroshan Dickwella is caught leg before on 94. He's given out but given the current scenario, he's taken the review against the decision. Looks out to the naked eye.
Shorter on middle, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Drives it through extra cover for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut towards point from the crease.
SIX! Up and over! Floated outside off, Mendis gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over square leg for a maximum. 100-RUN STAND UP!
Tucked towards square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Dickwella reverse sweeps this one through third man for a couple of runs.
Floated on off, Kusal heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR Leg Byes! Dickwella again goes for the pull but gets it down to the fine leg region for a boundary. That was more of a top edge that went off the arm.
FOUR! In the gap! Holder bangs it short on off, Dickwella rolls his wrists over this pull and gets it to the backward square leg fence for a boundary. Moves into the nineties!
Slower one that dipped in on Dickwella, kept out by the batsman.
FLASHED! Short outside off, Kusal throws his bat at it and gets it down to third man for a single.
Shorter on off, controlled pull down to long leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a single.
JASON HOLDER brings himself back into the attack.
DRINKS BREAK!
Shorter on off, played back down the wicket.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Dickwella fails to sweep. A wide is signaled.
Floated on middle, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on the pads, tucked towards square leg for a run.
Floated on off, turns in, turned towards mid-wicket by Dickwella.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller outside off, Dickwella slinks down the wicket and goes inside out over  covers for a boundary.
Floated on off, reverse swept to short third man.
Fuller outside off, Kusal drives it on the up back towards the bowler who stops it in his followthrough.
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella taps it towards covers and calls Kusal through for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers off his crease.
Shorter length on middle, Dickwella controls his pull through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller on middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Kusal Mendis!
FOUR! FIFTY! Angled on a length on middle and leg, Kusal Mendis gets across and clips it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. That is also fifty for him.
Mendis drives this one through mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Mendis looks to sweep but misses it this time.
Bowls the arm ball on off, goes straight, Kusal Mendis pushes it towards point.
FOUR! In the gap! Kusal Mendis gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. There was no intent to keep that one down as the ball bounces into the ropes.
Drives this one towards short extra cover.
Mendis comes forward and keeps this one out.
Too full on the pads, Kusal clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Bouncer! Bangs it short on off and middle, Mendis ducks under it.
Hurls it on a length outside off, driven nicely towards mid off but not in the gap.
Fuller outside off, driven towards wide mid off for a single.
Slanted outside off, another mistimed drive from Dickwella towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella looks to drive but gets it off the inside half back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, mistimes his drive back down the wicket.
FOUR! POWERFUL! Benn drops it fuller on middle, Kusal gets down on it and sweeps it hard through mid-wicket. That was powerfully hit.
Shorter on off, punched towards point by Kusal Mendis off his back foot.
Floated on off, Dickwella comes down and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Kusal looks to cut but gets a bottom edge past the keeper for a single.
Floated outside off, Kusal drives it towards covers.
A bit fullish in length once more, it's driven back to mid on with a straight blade and that will be the end of the over.
Pitched just ahead of a length, it's on the stumps as Niroshan plays it towards mid on.

That's gone right through! Excellent stuff from Shannon Gabriel. Maintains a good line and he's bowled this with great pace. Good length delivery just around off, 143 kph, it shapes in a shade as Dickwella looks to put bat on ball. Goes right between bat and pad and whiskers past the off pole.
On a length outside off, it's run down to third man for a single.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot. Fuller length ball on off, Kusal Mendis stands forward and with a beautiful, straight blade drives it back past mid off to send it all the way.
Just back of a length on off, Kusal Mendis stays back and keeps it out.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back into the attack.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Keeps a bit low as Benn tosses it up outside off, Mendis looks to drag the sweep on the leg side but the ball goes under his bat.
50-run stand up between Kusal Mendis and Niroshan Dickwella!
Floated around the off pole, eased back down the ground towards the long off fielder for one.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. Two runs added to the total.
Full from Sulieman Benn, Dickwella is hit on the pads as he attempts to sweep it away.
No turn on that whatsoever as the ball holds its line, wristed to square leg and one run is taken.
Flatter on the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket for a run. That brings an end to Kraigg Brathwaite effort with the ball. He ends with figures of 10-0-56-1. He's bowled them all on the trot.
FOUR! Shorter and flatter on the body, Mendis makes good use of the crease. Goes deep inside and pulls it across the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
This full delivery is driven back down towards long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Mendis punches it square on the off side and jogs to the other end to get off strike.

Chance of a run out. Close call. Niroshan Dickwella gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to covers. Sets off for a quick run as a throw is fired in at the striker's end. He misses as Mendis dives to get back in. One run completed.
From around the wicket, it's sliding in on middle and leg, Niroshan gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side. Gets a couple of runs for doing so.
Fullish on the stumps, blocked off the front foot to end the over.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Sulieman Benn gives this some decent air as he bowls it quite slow through the air, Mendis steps out and lofts it over covers. He did not get all of it and it falls well short of sweeper cover. A single completed.
It's driven down the ground again but this time it's towards long on. One run taken.
Tossed up delivery on off stump, Kusal Mendis drives it back down to long off for a single.
Loopy and on a length outside off, Mendis cuts it away behind square on the off side for no run.
Shorter in length, Mendis half-pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and off the inside half works it to mid-wicket for one run.
Full ball from Kraigg Brathwaite, it's eased down to long on for a single.
On the shorter side once more, it's kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, a gift for Mendis. Big gift. He accepts it gracefully as he goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Slower in pace and shorter in length outside off, Dickwella off his back foot punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
It's hit down to long on for another single.
Bowls it quite slower through the air around the off stump, Kusal Mendis rocks onto his back foot and punches it through towards sweeper cover for a single.
On the fuller side once more, Dickwella leans across a touch and turns it to the square leg region for one more.
Flights this one up outside off, Kusal Mendis leans forward and drives it through the covers for one.
Loopy and fullish around off, kept out off the front foot and into the track ahead.
Shortish on the stumps, Mendis off his back foot punches it down to long on for a single.
Niroshan Dickwella dances down the wicket and works it to mid-wicket. A slight confusion between the two batsmen but they manage to get across and into the crease.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Short in length and well outside off, room on offer too. Mendis has all the time in the world to rock back and crunch it through the gap in the covers. Picks up a boundary as the ball races away to the boundary line.
Flatter on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket. No run taken.
WIDE! Going down leg, wide called by the umpire.
Niroshan waits for this one as it's pitched on a shorter length. Goes back and then cuts it away square on the off side for one run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Looped up outside off, the left-hander reverse sweeps this away. Cannot beat the backward point fielder though.
Turn and bounce for Sulieman Benn. He gives it a lot of air and pitches it around off, it turns in and bounces a lot too as it just about beats the outside edge.
Gets to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Benn gives this some decent flight and pitches it on a fullish length around off, Dickwella leans ahead and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Floats it up outside off, Mendis leans across and pushes it to the covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Niroshan Dickwella stays deep within his crease and blocks it out.
Flatter ball on the pads, it's worked gently to the leg side for one more.
Works this towards the mid-wicket region and a single is taken.
Sliding in from around off, quicker in pace and that almost did Dickwella in. He still manages to get back and punch it square on the off side.
Loopy and fullish in length well outside off, Niroshan Dickwella has nothing to do with it.
Straighter one from Brathwaite, from around the wicket, it's sliding in on the stumps as Mendis goes back to pull it. He does well to get it through mid-wicket and takes a single for it.
Floated on off, reverse swept to backward point from his crease.
Drives it through covers for a single.
Plays it towards point off his crease.
Tossed up outside off, bounces a bit more with the spin and is beaten all ends up.
Floated outside off, driven to point from his crease.
Begins with a full toss outside off, Dickwella squeezes it down to third man. The fielder fields the ball as the outfield is a touch slow and that allows them to take three.
SULIEMANN BENN comes on for a bowl.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! That's a good catch! Dhananjaya de Silva departs. Tossed up and it's bowled slower through the air, de Silva drives it in the air to the right of the bowler. Kraigg Brathwaite hops to the side and sticks his right hand out to take it. He keeps a hold of it and that brings an end to the 105-run stand. Much needed wicket for the Windies.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower and shorter, on the stumps once more, Dhananjaya goes back and pulls it through the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up and attacking the stumps, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker through the air, around off, punched towards cover. No run taken.
Short and flat around off, it's punched off the back foot down to long off for a single.
Plays this with the spin and turns it to the leg side for a single to end the over.
Full on the stumps, it's driven towards long on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
100-run stand between de Silva and Dickwella!
FOUR! That fell a little short but Gabriel should have done better there. He uppishly plays this towards mid off. Falls just short of Shannon who cannot stop the ball from going through him.
Floated and on the stumps, it's swept away through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Comes forward to this fullish delivery and defends it into the track.
Gets back to this shorter one and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
3rd ODI fifty for Dhananjaya de Silva!
FOUR! Fifty for de Silva. Solid knock from the opener. He gets low to this one and paddles it away across the third man fence for a boundary.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to covers for one.
On middle and leg, Niroshan kneels and scoops it but fails to get it past the short fine leg fielder.
Darts this on the pads, no trouble for Dhananjaya de Silva to flick it through deep square leg for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side to end the over.
On a flatter trajectory once more, this time Dhananjaya hangs back and tucks it 'round the corner for one good run.
Turning in on a shorter length, it's worked to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Maiden ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella!
Tossed up around the off stump, Niroshan Dickwella skips down the track and eases it down to long off for a single. Brings up his fifty with that.
Fullish and pitched outside off, it's eased to covers for nothing.
Short, flat and outside off, Dickwella gets a bottom edge back in the direction of the bowler as he looks to cut it away.
Drinks break!
Quicker on leg stump, Dhananjaya de Silva works it towards short mid-wicket. It was in the air but it fell short of the fielder there.
Floats this one up as Dickwella comes down the track, uppishly plays it towards long on for one.
This is bowled slower through the air by Kraigg Brathwaite, Dickwella stays back and keeps it on on the leg side.
Turning away from a length outside off, punched away square on the off side off the back foot for no run.
Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up on the stumps, it's driven down towards long on for a single.
Full and loopy outside off, de Silva slogs it through mid-wicket. Johnson Charles out in the deep comes across and cuts it off. Two runs taken.
Floated on off, turns in, played through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down and turns it through wide mid on for a run.
Dickwella pushes it towards covers from his crease.
FOUR! IN THE GAP! Stays back and cuts this one behind point and in the gap for a boundary.
Shorter on off, Dickwella cuts it off the stumps towards short third man.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler by Dickwella.
Shorter on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Slower on middle and leg, Dickwella comes down but is hit on his pads.
Gabriel is back on the field!
Stays back and cuts it through point for a single.
Very wide outside off, de Silva gets down on his knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a couple.
Dickwella pushes it to covers and this time takes a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Dickwella comes down and pushes it towards covers.
Shorter on off, placed through point for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched down to long on for a single.
Landed on off, dabbed through cover-point for a single.
Comes down and plays it back to the bowler.
Defends this one off his back foot.
EDGED! Dropped! Short outside off, Dickwella gets an edge that flies past the keeper towards short third man. Replays show it touched the keeper's gloves. Tough chance, that!
Dickwella slinks down and drives it through mid off for a single.
Finally places this one through point for a single.
Comes forward and drives it to mid off but not in the gap.
Very short and wide, de Silva cuts it but finds the fielder at point.
Cuts this one towards covers from his crease.
Floated outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, de Silva gets across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Drives this through covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella comes down and pushes it towards mid off but the bowler runs to his right and stops it.
FOUR! Top batting! Fired in on the stumps, Dickwella sits down and sweeps this through square leg for a boundary.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! de Silva looks to play the big shot but gets it on the bounce to sweeper cover for a single.
de Silva stays back and punches it to mid on.
Flatter on the pads, Dickwella turns it towards short mid-wicket from his crease.
Dickwella pushes this one back to the bowler coming forward.
Drops it short outside off, Dickwella looks to cut but finds the fielder at short third man.
Worked through mid on for a single off the back foot.
Floated outside off, Dickwella comes down the wicket and pushes it through covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Silva punches it back down the ground for a single.
KRAIGG BRATHWAITE is brought on to bowl.
Turned through mid on for a single.
Fuller on off, de Silva mistimes his on drive back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, de Silva looks to cut but is beaten.
Outside off, comes down and drives it through mid off for a single.
Floated on off, worked behind square on the leg side for a run.
50-run stand up between Dickwella and de Silva.
Shorter on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg for a single.
ASHLEY NURSE introduced into the attack.
de Silva looks to pull this one through but is hit on his body.
FOUR! You bowl short you get hit, you bowl full, you get hit! Carlos floats this one up outside off, de Silva hammers it back past the bowler for a boundary. West Indies look lost at the moment.

FOUR! de Silva continues to play his shots! Short and wide outside off, de Silva cuts it in the air towards point. There are shouts of catch it but there needs to be someone there to take it. The ball runs down to the fence and Carlos is not happy with himself.
Short again outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella looks to dab it through but fails to connect.
BEATEN! Shorter outside off, Dickwella looks to upper cut it but is beaten.

Poor work from West Indies! Angles this on a length outside off, de Silva hops and hits it towards cover-point where the fielder runs to his right, dives but cannot stop the ball and they get a couple of runs. Holder is not impressed.
Outside off on a length, de Silva covers the line and defends it back.
Good length outside off, Dickwella runs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller on middle and off, Dickwella again gets across and scoops it over the fine leg region for a boundary. The intent is right there from Sri Lanka!
de Silva gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angled on a length on middle, de Silva fails to clip it through.

SIX! The Windies are feeling the heat here! Fuller on middle and leg, Dickwella gets across and this time he whips it over the square leg fence. The third umpire checks whether it is a boundary or a six. The ball seems to have bounced over the ropes so it will be a six. This is poor bowling but some serious batting from Sri Lanka. 50 up for them!
Slants another one outside off, on a fuller length, left alone.
This one is slanted across on a good length, no shot offered by Dickwella.

FOUR! Take that! Bowls it on middle and leg, Dickwella gets across, sits down and scoops it through the fine leg region for a boundary. That was superbly done. The pressure is on Brathwaite here, who has not begun well.
There is a deep mid-wicket in place now.
And again, Dickwella lofts this one over mid-wicket with a chip for another brace. The outfield is slow and that is not helping the batsmen here.
Fuller on middle, Dickwella leans on it and mistimes his loft over mid-wicket. A couple of runs taken.
FOUR! Hit away! Fuller outside off, de Silva waits for it and slams it down the ground to the left of the bowler for a boundary. Nobody moved there!
Fuller on middle and leg, de Silva fails to clip it through as the ball rolls towards square leg.
Good cricket! Full outside off, Dickwella just pushes it to the right of Lewis at mid off. Lewis runs after it like a hare and saves a run for his side.
On off, Dickwella looks to clip but hits it too straight and the mid on fielder and mid off fielder almost collide trying to get to it. No harm done though.
This one is shorter one outside off, guided towards point from Dickwella.
Extra bounce! Dickwella looks to tuck this through square leg but gets it on the bounce to the fielder.
Brings this one in, de Silva keeps it out back down the wicket.
Dishes out a shorter one, goes away as de Silva throws his bat at it but cannot put bat to ball.
Much better! Bowls it outside off, de Silva has a poke at it but is beaten.

FOUR! Poor ball! You just enforced the off side field for the drive but Carlos bowls it short and wide outside off. de Silva needs no second invitation and crashes it through cover-point for a boundary.
Field change! Slip comes out, a short extra cover in place.
This time de Silva waits a touch more but still cannot find the gap with his drive to covers.
Fuller outside off, de Silva comes forward and drives it towards mid off.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes on for a bowl with Gabriel off the field.
Angled on a length on off, Dickwella defends it back down the wicket.

Fuller outside off, Dickwella again gets forward and drives it through extra cover. The fielder gives it a chase, does well to keep the ball in play. The fielder backing up returns a poor throw. Two runs taken.
On the pads, tucked down to fine leg for a single by de Silva.
Fuller outside off, de Silva pushes it towards mid off.
Bowls this from wide of the crease, angled on a length on off, de Silva covers the line and defends it.
Angled on a length on off, de Silva defends it from his crease.
Gabriel has gone off the field. West Indies will hope he is fine.
FOUR! Top shot! Full outside off, this time Dickwella pushes it through extra cover. Nurse from mid off looks to run after it but gives it up at the end. A boundary to get off the mark for Dickwella.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella drives it towards covers.
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a comeback by Gabriel! Bowls it at 148 kph, on middle and off, swings in a touch. Kusal looks to clip it through mid-wicket but fails to connect. The ball hits the pads and cannons into the stumps. Gabriel screams in joy and why not, any fast bowler loves the sight of the ball breaking the stumps.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Full outside off, Kusal waits for it and drives it through extra cover for a majestic boundary. He waited for it nicely and found the gap to perfection.
There seems to be something wrong with Gabriel here.
Good length outside off, de Silva gets it down to third man for a single with an open face of the bat.
Bowls it on the pads, Kusal fails to clip it. The ball goes off the pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.
Outside off, de Silva presses forward and pushes it to point.
Gabriel is getting some medical attention at the fine leg fence. He seems to have hurt his right leg.
de Silva tucks it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
This one is in the channel outside off, swings away, left alone by de Silva.
Overcompensates for the width, bowls it on the pads, de Silva clips it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! CRASHED! Fuller outside off, de Silva spots the width and sends it packing it through covers for a boundary. That was cleanly hit.
Hurls it outside off, Perera drives it wide of mid off for a single.
JASON HOLDER to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Fuller outside off, de Silva drives it nicely but to the fielder at mid off.
WIDE! Slips it down the leg side for a wide.
The physio is out in the middle. Kusal is hobbling but some medicines, pain-killers likely and he is ready to play again.

Attempts another yorker, Perera gets an inside edge onto his right boot. The ball rolls off the them towards the on side for a single. Perera completes the single but is down in pain. He calls for the physio right away.
Fuller on off, Perera pushes it towards mid off from his crease.
EDGED! Outside off, de Silva looks to defend but gets an outside edge down to third man for a single. Good effort in the deep to keep them to a run.
This time he gets it right, bowls a yorker on middle, Kusal digs it out towards fine leg for a single off the inside half of the bat.
Slips out a full toss outside off, de Silva pushes it through point for a single to get off the mark.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. KUSAL PERERA and DHANANJAYA DE SILVA are out to bat for Sri Lanka. West Indies begin with SHANNON GABRIEL!

SRI LANKA XI - Dhananjaya de Silva, Kusal Perera, Niroshan Dickwella(wk), Kusal Mendis, Upul Tharanga(c), Shehan Jayasuriya, Asela Gunaratne, Sachith Pathirana, Nuwan Kulasekara, Nuwan Pradeep, Suranga Lakmal.
WEST INDIES XI - Johnson Charles, Kraigg Brathwaite, Evin Lewis, Shai Hope(wk), Jonathan Carter, Rovman Powell, Carlos Brathwaite, Jason Holder(c), Ashley Nurse, Sulieman Benn, Shannon Gabriel.

Upul Tharanga begins by saying that they wanted to bowl first too. Mentions that there is grass and it should be a good one. Adds that it is a big game, no pressure on them. Hopes that they can do their best.

Jason Holder says that there is grass cover so they will want to extract the moisture. They had a close game against Zimbabwe but could not get past the line so hopefully they will do better. Adds they did silly mistakes, they are refreshed for this game.
TOSS - WEST INDIES HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO FIELD. They are unchanged from the previous game. Sri Lanka have made a couple of changes. We will have the teams for you in a bit.

PITCH REPORT - Pat Symcox doing the pitch report reckons that there is a light breeze. There is a lot of grass on this deck. He adds that it will seam around and the captain winning the toss will be itching to bowl first.

The outfield has taken a lot of beating so even an hour of rain today could spoil things for both teams. Let's hope the rain stays away, though the forecast is good but you can't trust them enough. Coming to the game, the Windies beat Sri Lanka handsomely in the previous encounter and will be hoping for an encore.  Sri Lanka will want their middle order to step up and ensure they do not leave things to permutations and combinations. With a win assuring a place in the final, expect a cracking contest. Stay tuned.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the 5th match of the tri-series between Sri Lanka and West Indies at Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo. The tournament is now alive and kicking, thanks to the tied game between Zimbabwe and West Indies along with the washout in the Zimbabwe-Sri Lanka encounter. Another washout today though, would rule out Zimbabwe from the tournament and the hosts will not want that to happen and will have their prayers going to keep the rain away.
